notes: Prices in JPY from SNKRDUNK. Listings filtered to 販売中のみ (for-sale only); top-20 cheapest active listings taken per grade, with a 15% cutoff above the lowest listing (threshold = lowest * 1.15) splitting them into within_15pct vs excluded_over_15pct. The site's 安い順 (cheapest-first) sort was applied and verified before extracting the top 20. recent_completed_sales are the most recent ~15-20 sales-history entries per grade, oldest-to-newest, filtered by the 状態 grade pill on the card's 売買履歴 section (rows leaking an unintended grade were discarded and noted via sales_note where applicable). PSA10 population/gem-rate sourced from altema.jp (pokekachi) for the 5 established cards, all re-verified unchanged from the prior run (same-day, ~5 hours earlier). image_url reused from the skill's cached table for all 11 cards (no re-fetching needed). This run (~12:25-12:50 JST) is a same-day follow-up to an earlier run (~07:36 JST) checking on the 6 new 30th CELEBRATION (M6a) cards, which released today. All 6 still have zero PSA10 listings/sales (PSA grading turnaround takes weeks, as expected) - this is unchanged from the morning run. However, altema.jp's coverage of these 6 cards changed meaningfully since the morning check: every one of the 6 prediction-article URLs (e.g. gengarexsar30th-price) now redirects to a permanent altema.jp/pokemoncard/card/<id> page with a real price table (買取価格/販売価格/メルカリ相場), rather than the old placeholder prediction-only article - but none of the 6 have a PSA10 population/gem-rate section yet, since no PSA10 submissions have graded back. The 6 M6a cards' A-grade (raw near-mint) markets continued to mature through the day: all 6 now show 11-20 active A-grade listings (up from more variable counts earlier) and active sales-history turnover in the tens-of-minutes-old range, indicating a fast-moving, still price-discovering secondary market on release day itself. Card 9 (ミュウツーex SAR) A-grade listings grew further to 20 (from 13 in the morning run). Card 4 (ゲンガーVMAX SA) continues to show very thin A-grade supply (only 1 active listing, unchanged) and a stale most-recent A sale (2026/06/29). psa_tier_status omitted this run (JST is Wednesday, not Monday; the weekly PSA Value-tier check runs Mondays only).
